acceptance_criteria: P2-010B implements only an internal, explicit, revision-only synthesis commit seam. It does not connect ordinary Orchestrator.run, resume, load_report, CLI run/resume/show, AppConfig.runs_dir, or an existing flat-v1 run ID to revision storage, because P2-012A rejects legacy/revision namespace overlap and P2-012B owns product integration.

The integration revalidates the exact P2-010A schema-1.0.0 Synthesis PhaseRequest and PhaseOutcome correlation for run_id, phase_id, attempt_id, context_ids, input_hash, policy_snapshot_hash, output_hash, status, requested_next_state, and artifact intents before any revision-store call; only a succeeded synthesis outcome requesting completed is admitted.

The orchestrator prepares phase-transition-plan-v1 while the machine is in FINAL_SYNTHESIS without mutation. Its frozen canonical JSON data fields are exactly schema_version 1.0.0, run_id, source FINAL_SYNTHESIS, target COMPLETED, literal reason durable synthesis revision committed, event_count, event_prefix_sha256, and plan_sha256. The prefix digest is SHA-256 over the domain bytes poker-phase-transition-event-prefix-v1 followed by one zero byte and compact ensure_ascii=false/sort_keys=true/allow_nan=false JSON for the ordered source/target/reason event list. plan_sha256 is SHA-256 over the analogous poker-phase-transition-plan-v1 zero-byte domain followed by the compact canonical JSON of exactly the preceding seven data fields, excluding plan_sha256. Illegal, stale, non-factory-issued, divergent, wrong-reason, wrong-version, or non-synthesis plans fail closed before publication.

The coordinator binds each admitted non-state artifact intent to an exact canonical payload byte sequence and lowercase SHA-256. A null outcome content hash is deterministically filled in the persisted PhaseBindingV1 snapshot from those admitted bytes; a nonnull hash must already match. The state.json intent remains represented but is not materialized because P2-012A is structural_nonterminal and P2-012B owns durable state checkpoints.

The proposed revision contains the complete P2-012A-admitted source graph needed for the synthesis artifacts and exact typed provenance. PhaseBindingV1, ContextBindingV1, ToolBindingV1, BudgetPolicyBindingV1, SourceBindingV1, approval, report, assignment, tool, run, attempt, policy, and context correlations must replay successfully under the separately approved poker-final-report-artifact-v2 contract. P2-010B itself changes no storage canonical/model/store code or version: final report v1 remains lexical-order plus mandatory-context, while v2 validates one identical input/result binding per execution, unique contiguous projected ordinals, ordinal report order, and exactly zero context only for a trace with no agent reports and no execution records.

The internal frozen phase trace includes the exact Synthesis request/outcome, every contributing ContextBuild request/outcome, every Analysis request/outcome, and every ToolResearch request/outcome with complete ToolExecutionBinding values. The coordinator revalidates phase hashes and correlations, ContextDispatch and envelope integrity/assignment/allowlist/attempt-memory-only policy at the recorded creation boundary, validate_analysis_output, and validate_tool_research_output, derives the persisted PhaseBindingV1 and ContextBindingV1 values from those preimages, and rejects missing, extra, duplicate, self-consistent-hash-only, or cross-trace provenance. Raw ContextEnvelope, ContextPolicy, AgentContext, dispatch, provider input, and phase-trace preimages stay in memory and are never passed as revision artifacts.

ToolRequest input bytes, ToolResult bytes, requested/supported/result contract versions, request and result IDs, unique contiguous execution ordinals, phase attempt IDs, source/policy hashes, deterministic calculator evidence, seed/sample/iteration/stopping metadata, warnings, errors, and reproduction metadata come from the complete in-memory ToolResearch trace and admitted canonical artifacts. FinalReport.tool_results remains in execution ordinal order even when result IDs have a different UTF-8 lexical order. The integration does not reconstruct a ToolRequest from only ToolResult, rerun a tool or provider effect, reorder or rewrite report bytes, or rewrite numeric evidence.

Before calling RunRevisionStore.publish, the coordinator applies exact-payload-restricted-secret-scan-v1. Each artifact must be no larger than configured RunRevisionStore.max_artifact_bytes and strict UTF-8; JSON scans every recursively parsed object key and string value, JSONL scans every nonempty line the same way, and Markdown scans the whole decoded text. Object keys use case-insensitive substring regex api[-_]?key|authorization|bearer|cookie|password|passwd|secret|token|private[-_]?key|client[-_]?(secret|credential)|credential. Every string value and Markdown text use the exact case-insensitive union regex from P2-027A storage control metadata: \bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\b; \bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b; \bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}\b; \b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b; \bAIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b; \beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}\b; \bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}\b; \bnpm_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b; \b(?:rk|sk)_(?:live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}\b; \bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{8,}\b; and (?:api[-_]?key|password|passwd|secret|token)\s*[:=]. It additionally rejects -----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY----- and case-insensitive \b(?:api[-_]?key|access[-_]?token|password|client[-_]?secret)\b\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_./+=-]{12,}. Parse failure, unsupported media/serialization, sensitive/restricted/unknown/downgraded classification, or caller evidence disagreement fails closed.

Every caught coordinator validation, scanner, canonical, and storage Exception is consumed inside a minimal catch boundary and mapped only to a frozen phase-revision-failure-v1 data value with exactly schema_version 1.0.0 and one closed code from invalid_trace, invalid_plan, secret_detected, unsupported_payload, persistence_denied, publish_conflict, publish_uncertain, authorization_mismatch, apply_failed, or apply_unknown. The public coordinator result is a closed success-or-failure data union: phase-revision-failure-v1 is never raised as an exception, contains no exception member, and no caught exception, __cause__, __context__, __traceback__, traceback frame, frame local, raw byte, matched value, ContextEnvelope canonical payload, AgentContext, PhaseRequest/Outcome repr, provider/tool input, or secret crosses or is retained by the seam. The catch boundary emits no raw log or warning and constructs/returns the closed value without embedding or chaining the caught object. Parametrized canaries cover every credential family in innocuous JSON keys, CaseInput.raw_text, nested JSONL, ToolResult, and Markdown with mutation-zero denial; they recursively inspect the returned union, str/repr/log/warning captures, and any exposed object graph to prove that no BaseException, traceback, frame, frame local, canary, or raw payload is reachable.

ContextPolicy and ContextEnvelope remain schema 1.0.0 and attempt-memory-only-v1. Only typed non-secret context identity, classification, source hash, policy hash, lineage, expiry, producer/consumer runtime, envelope hash, and phase input/output hash commitments may persist; provider use-expiry and storage retention remain separate. Provider prompts, ContextEnvelope.canonical_payload, ContextPolicy, AgentContext, dispatch objects, provider payloads, and phase trace preimages are never persisted. A clean approved CaseInput raw_text remains an existing input.json/normalized_case.json field and is not mislabelled as a provider prompt. No secret, retention executor, or lifecycle hook is added.

The transaction_id is the stable idempotency key for the whole canonical RevisionPublishRequestV1. Exact replay must reuse the entire request and digest; same transaction with different bytes fails as idempotency_conflict, stale expected revision fails as run_conflict, overlap fails as run_locked, and P2-010B performs zero automatic retry or wait.

The coordinator returns a frozen nonserializable same-process phase-transition-authorization-v1 only after RunRevisionStore.publish returns published or exact current_committed. Its exact data fields are schema_version 1.0.0, plan, run_id_sha256, transaction_id, transaction_sha256, revision, manifest_sha256, pointer_sha256, and outcome_kind published or current_committed, plus one repr-hidden compare-false private issuer-capability identity that is neither a data field nor persistable. A private factory issues it only from one frozen request/plan bundle after matching the complete outcome run hash, transaction identity/digest, revision, manifest, pointer, closed durability/reconciliation matrix, and confirmed authority release; storage does not contain or attest plan_sha256. Apply requires the exact factory-issued capability identity, exact plan self-hash, exact authorization data, the original in-memory bundle identity, and a fresh matching machine preview. historical_committed, reconciliation_required, every RunStorageError, effect_unknown, current_may_have_advanced, release failure, outcome mismatch, reconstructed/reparsed authorization, or any value not issued by that factory returns no authority.

The orchestrator, not the coordinator and not an arbitrary callback, applies an authorized plan through one state-machine lock and a closed applied/already_applied/apply_failed/apply_unknown result. All validation and injected pre-mutation faults occur before replacing the event list and state and return apply_failed; exact event already present returns already_applied; response loss after mutation is reconciled under the same lock to already_applied when exact, otherwise apply_unknown. Exact concurrent replay creates at most one FINAL_SYNTHESIS-to-COMPLETED event, stale/divergent/forged authorization fails closed, and no rollback is claimed.

Fault injection covers forged request/outcome/binding values, secret/classification mismatch, preflight refusal, lock contention and API failure, metadata/namespace/staging/payload/manifest/revision rename faults, CAS and pointer ambiguity, directory-sync failure, lock-release failure, current/historical replay, idempotency payload conflict, orphan/reconciliation outcome, pre-apply and post-observation apply faults, concurrent writer, and concurrent exact replay. No denied or uncertain storage outcome authorizes COMPLETED.

A published structural revision followed by an in-memory apply failure is reported as apply_failed or apply_unknown without rollback or deletion claims. Recovery is limited to exact request replay plus idempotent apply against a matching live machine; process-restart reconstruction, durable resume, terminal visibility, public completed status, migration, and orphan repair remain P2-012B or later.

Windows directory-sync unavailable may authorize a successfully reconciled published outcome only for the tested local cooperating-process visibility contract. P2-010B makes no power-loss, hardware-cache, cross-volume, UNC, SMB, NFS, distributed, malicious-writer, universal directory-durability, or process-crash state-recovery claim.

Ordinary flat-v1 behavior remains byte/order/signature compatible, including Orchestrator.run/resume/load_report, CLI commands and exit codes, CaseInput, FinalReport, ToolResult, serial phase order, golden normalization, calculation assignment artifacts, and the assigned-but-unexecuted report-writer. The characterized flat-v1 COMPLETED-before-final-report-write fault remains explicitly unresolved and is not represented as fixed by this opt-in seam.

P2-010A phase contracts remain versioned internal APIs and are not exported as stable package-root APIs. Pure phases still do no filesystem, state-machine, provider, tool, network, approval-ledger, ambient-clock, or ambient-random mutation; provider and tool effects remain behind their existing executors, and only the orchestrator may request or apply a transition.

Execution remains serial with zero automatic retries and peak concurrency one. P2-010B does not add durable usage, reservation, multi-process budget CAS, retry scheduling, parallel agents, cancellation fan-out, provider execution, external solver execution, runtime bridges, sandboxing, or approval CAS, and it does not change budget observation or settlement semantics.

P2-010B accepts only poker-final-report-artifact-v2 on a dedicated revision root whose ownership marker exactly matches RunRevisionStore producer_id p2-010b-phase-revision and producer_version 0.2.0. Before the target run's initial publication, inspection must prove that target run has no current pointer or revision history; histories for other run IDs are outside this check. After a published revision exists, only an explicit same-process replay of the original frozen request/plan bundle whose run, transaction, transaction digest, revision, manifest, and pointer exactly produce current_committed is exempt; different transaction, historical, successor, reconstructed, or cross-process replay is denied. Same-canonical-build, no-mixed-build, and no-rolling access are trusted deployment assumptions which the unchanged schemas cannot attest, detect, or prevent, so violation is unsupported rather than claimed to fail closed. Producer mismatch, nonexact target-run history, v1 final report, or old reader fails; new readers retain v1 read support, old readers reject explicit v2, and no cross-build availability, migration, rewrite, or conversion claim is made.

Capabilities, doctor, README, architecture, phase, storage, security, context, budget, tool, limitation, and generated roadmap docs state the narrow internal structural integration and separately approved final-report artifact v2 boundary truthfully. immutable_revision_storage_foundation stays implemented; product_integrated_durable_run stays planned; no GTO, equilibrium, exploitability, exact-range, external-provider, external-solver, parallel, retry, terminal, resume, migration, cleanup, encryption, or secure-erase capability is promoted.

After the separately approved split-milestone governance and final-report artifact v2 amendments, roadmap sequencing is append-only: scope freeze binds this exact scope and post-approval digest while P2-010B remains not_started and RM-010 remains in_progress; implementation start changes only P2-010B to in_progress; completion changes P2-010B and RM-010 to completed with exact approved path/test evidence. P2-011B and P2-012B remain approval null and not_started.

Candidate and exact-final-HEAD gates run every approved test plus full pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy src, roadmap generate/check --require-tracked, doctor JSON, management JSON/JSONL validation, ignore/untracked/nonstage guards, git diff --check, and four independent reviews. Completion evidence is created only after candidate High=0 and Medium=0, and push occurs only after final High=0 and Medium=0 with every Low fixed or concretely accepted.

The branch is created only after explicit approval of all three proposals and baseline revalidation. Commits are separated into split-milestone governance amendment, final-report artifact v2 amendment, P2-010B scope freeze, implementation start, coordinator/state contract, orchestrator integration, fault/concurrency/security remediation, docs/review remediation, and completion evidence; only exact phase-specific allowlisted paths are staged, push is non-force, and ignored management data remains untracked, unstaged, uncommitted, unpushed, untransmitted, and undeleted.

tests/unit/__init__.py is a content-free package marker used only to give the approved unit coordinator module an import identity distinct from the approved integration module under the repository's unchanged default pytest command. It contains no Python token, fixture, hook, configuration, runtime import, product behavior, or test weakening; a zero-byte file or one LF byte is content-free for this purpose. The top-level tests and tests/integration directories remain non-packages so existing from conftest imports retain their prior meaning. Both approved same-basename modules collect together, the exact approved-test command and python -m pytest succeed without an import-file-mismatch, and removing the unit marker reproduces that collection failure.

policy_decisions: Current implementation FACT: P2-010A is completed, P2-012A is completed, RM-010 is in_progress, P2-010B is not_started with approval null, P2-011B and P2-012B are not_started with approval null, and immutable revision storage is an opt-in structural_nonterminal foundation disconnected from ordinary product runs.

Implement P2-010B only; do not implement P2-011B, P2-012B, P2-013A/B, P2-027B, P2-028A, or later work. Record P2-011B only as the next proposal-only handoff in ignored management data after P2-010B completion.

Resolve the legacy/revision namespace conflict by choosing an internal explicit revision-only synthesis commit seam. Do not dual-write a normal flat-v1 run, use a different run ID to evade binding, alter the P2-012A namespace refusal, or connect run/resume/show before P2-012B.

Add phases/revision_coordinator.py as an internal module without package-root or phases.__init__ export. Preserve P2-010A and P2-012A schema versions and do not modify revision_models.py, revision_canonical.py, revision_lock.py, revision_store.py, run_store.py, config.py, cli.py, phases/contracts.py, phases/models.py, phases/services.py, or phases/executors.py in P2-010B. The separately approved final-report artifact v2 amendment must be completed first.

The revision coordinator accepts an orchestrator-owned frozen trace of already-computed ContextBuild, Analysis, ToolResearch, and Synthesis strict request/outcome values plus a complete canonical revision request; it performs preimage correlation, exact-byte classification, materialized-intent, canonical, outcome, and authorization validation around RunRevisionStore.publish. It may rerun pure validation functions but never reruns a provider/tool effect, invokes a state transition or filesystem callback, starts a retry loop, performs cleanup, or accepts an arbitrary mutation callback.

Only Synthesis with status succeeded and requested_next_state completed can produce a transition plan or authorization. completed_with_failures, failed, missing output, non-synthesis phase, null/other target, schema mismatch, hash mismatch, warning-based policy violation, or any forged correlation fails closed.

Represent the pending state change as phase-transition-plan-v1 with the exact serialized data fields, literal reason durable synthesis revision committed, domain-separated compact canonical event-prefix and plan hashes fixed in the acceptance criteria. Preview is pure. The nonserializable same-process phase-transition-authorization-v1 has the exact frozen data fields and repr-hidden private factory capability fixed in the acceptance criteria; it correlates the original in-memory request/plan bundle to exact publication identities without claiming that storage attests plan_sha256. Apply is orchestrator-owned, lock-serialized, idempotent, rejects non-factory-issued, reconstructed, tampered, stale, or mismatched values, and emits no duplicate event.

Persist no state.json payload, completion marker, terminal manifest/pointer, verified product status, resume checkpoint, migration record, retention anchor, or lifecycle action. The PhaseBindingV1 may retain the exact state intent identity while canonical storage continues to skip state intent materialization.

For every non-state intent, compute content_sha256 from the exact admitted canonical bytes. Preserve any correct nonnull phase hash, reject disagreement, and deterministically materialize a null phase hash in the persisted binding; do not accept an intent without its required payload or an admitted payload outside the declared source graph.

Require the separately approved poker-final-report-artifact-v2 canonical validator to replay the complete provenance graph and preserve v1 semantics separately. For v2, project one exact identical input/result ToolBinding per execution, require ordinals 0 through n-1, compare report results by ordinal, and require context if and only if provider reports/execution records exist. Correlate run, revision, transaction, phase, attempt, context, policy, assignment, agent execution, tool request/result, report, evidence, approval, source, and budget identities without byte rewrite.

Carry exact ContextBuild, Analysis, ToolResearch, and Synthesis PhaseRequest/PhaseOutcome preimages in a frozen internal trace. Revalidate ContextDispatch, assignment_sha256, ContextEnvelope integrity/policy/payload/source hashes, attempt identity, allowlist/blind isolation, Analysis output, ToolExecutionBinding, and phase hashes before deriving persisted hash-only bindings. Reject missing/extra/cross-run/cross-attempt or hash-only forged provenance; never persist the raw trace.

Carry complete ToolExecutionBinding values before any projection to ToolResult. Preserve exact canonical ToolRequest input and ToolResult bytes, require exactly one identical binding across each input/result pair, project one binding per execution, require unique contiguous ordinals 0 through n-1, and preserve all reproduction metadata; never infer missing request fields from a result, reorder FinalReport.tool_results, or rerun a calculator or solver.

Use exact-payload-restricted-secret-scan-v1 before building P2-027A classification evidence: scan at most configured max_artifact_bytes per artifact; decode strict UTF-8; recursively scan every JSON/JSONL object key and string value and all Markdown text; implement the complete exact P2-027A/storage-control GitHub, AWS, Google, JWT, Slack, npm, Stripe, OpenAI-style, Bearer, assignment, access-token/client-secret, and PEM private-key families fixed in the acceptance criteria. Clean internal/public is the only persistable result; detected secret, sensitive/restricted/unknown classification, caller evidence disagreement, parse failure, unsupported serialization/media, or over-limit input is a mutation-zero prepublish denial.

Catch every raw-trace, scanner, canonical, and storage Exception at a minimal internal boundary and return only the phase-revision-failure-v1 closed redacted data union; never raise that failure value or return, attach, chain, log, warn, or retain any exception object. Never expose or retain a raw trace, matched secret, canonical payload, tool/provider input, underlying ValidationError repr, __cause__, __context__, __traceback__, traceback frame/local, BaseException, or canary in str/repr/results/logs/warnings/fault output or any reachable returned object graph; adversarial tests cover every credential family and failure surface.

Keep ContextEnvelope/ContextPolicy 1.0.0, attempt-memory-only-v1, fresh attempt identity, blind isolation, classification/source/policy hashes, lineage, expiry, and producer/consumer runtime semantics. Persist derived hashes and typed provenance only, never ContextEnvelope.canonical_payload, ContextPolicy, AgentContext, dispatch/provider payload, or phase-trace preimages. Existing clean CaseInput raw_text in approved run input artifacts remains permitted and is not a provider prompt.

Use the RevisionPublishRequestV1 transaction_id and canonical transaction digest as the idempotency identity. Allow no automatic retry even when a failure is semantically retryable; expose deterministic failure/uncertainty to the caller. The only admitted explicit replay is the original same-process frozen request/plan bundle and may authorize only exact current_committed; process-restart reconstruction or a newly previewed plan is denied and remains a non-goal.

Authorize only published or exact current_committed after all outcome fields, current identity, reconciliation, durability contract, and lock release are confirmed. Deny historical_committed, reconciliation_required, RunStorageError, effect_unknown, current_may_have_advanced, release failure, outcome mismatch, or any response outside the closed allowlist.

Treat Windows directory_sync unavailable as successful only where the existing published outcome contract permits it and document the limited local cooperating-process visibility. Make no power-loss, network filesystem, distributed, malicious writer, or restart-resume guarantee.

The failure matrix is closed: pure validation and secret/classification failures are mutation-zero; lock contention/API failure, quota, CAS, idempotency conflict, metadata, namespace, staging, payload, manifest, rename, pointer, directory-sync, release, historical replay, orphan, and reconciliation outcomes never authorize transition unless the exact published/current_committed allowlist is satisfied.

The recovery matrix is closed: prepublish failure leaves no transition; partial/unreferenced writes remain P2-012A-described orphans; uncertain current/release outcomes require reconciliation and no transition; pre-apply fault leaves a committed structural revision and a non-COMPLETED live machine; exact current replay can reauthorize and idempotently apply; durable restart, public status, repair, rollback, delete, and migration are non-goals.

The concurrency matrix is closed: one nonblocking revision writer may publish, overlapping writers receive RunLocked or a deterministic conflict, stale expected values receive RunConflict, exact concurrent replay can yield current_committed but at most one matching state event, and no scheduling parallelism or wait loop is introduced.

Preserve normal Orchestrator.run/resume/load_report and CLI signatures, output meanings, flat-v1 layout and artifact write order, golden behavior, calculation assignment artifact, and assigned-but-unexecuted report-writer. Normal flat-v1 bytes are not silently adopted, copied, deleted, migrated, or dual-written.

Explicitly retain the known flat-v1 fault in which COMPLETED/state can precede a later final-report write failure. P2-010B proves no-COMPLETED-on-failure only for its opt-in revision-only seam and must not overstate ordinary product atomicity.

Concurrent writer semantics are: the P2-012A run authority and expected revision/manifest/pointer CAS select one winner, losers return run_locked or cas_conflict without lost update, and exact replay after winner publication returns the unique recorded operation outcome.

Windows semantics inherit P2-012A exact path confinement, reparse/hardlink rejection, byte-range locking, verified atomic replace, file sync, and directory-sync evidence; unavailable directory sync remains unavailable evidence and is not upgraded to confirmed durability.

acceptance_criteria: Strict frozen durable models represent one policy, execution activation, usage snapshot, resource reservation, permit, attempt lineage, settlement, cancellation, idempotency operation, failure, and immutable state without coercion, unknown fields, non-finite values, negative units, duplicate identities, or mutable nested state.

Existing BudgetPolicyV2, BudgetSnapshot, UsageDelta, SerialUsageLedger, retry classification, config migration, phase contracts, and ordinary schema 2.0.0 behavior remain byte- and value-compatible; P2-011B adds a separate internal durable contract instead of silently changing P2-011A semantics.

The internal durable execution activation defaults to serial execution, zero automatic retries, and peak concurrency one; bounded parallelism up to 32 and retries up to the existing strict policy limit are available only through the newly approved internal P2-011B API and are not connected to the ordinary product path.

A dedicated explicitly initialized P2-011B structural revision root with producer p2-011b-durable-budget version 0.1.0 stores budget_state.json using artifact schema poker-durable-budget-state-artifact-v1 and storage protocol poker-run-revision-v1; it never adopts or mutates a flat-v1 product run or the P2-010B dedicated root.

Every durable state binds run ID, generation, previous state hash, full policy and activation hashes, cumulative usage, active reservations, closed settlements, attempts, retry lineage, cancellation state, operation idempotency records, failure latch, and deterministic event order to the immutable revision and exact artifact bytes.

An internal structural artifact-history read verifies the P2-012A current-to-genesis chain, immutable payload identity, size, hash, schema, and stable current pointer before returning budget bytes; it does not infer terminal, completed, resumable-product, or migrated status and is not exported as a product reader.

Resume reconstructs the same policy, activation, usage, reservations, settlements, attempts, cancellation, and event lineage from verified structural revisions; policy or activation substitution, history gaps, generation mismatch, previous-state hash mismatch, and cross-run replay fail closed.

A policy revision is an explicit idempotent durable operation with old/new policy hashes and a non-secret reason hash; it may only tighten limits, may not reduce a limit below used plus active-reserved resources, may not increase concurrency or retry activation, and never mutates historical policy state.

Durable active runtime uses injected monotonic nanoseconds, persists accumulated elapsed time and remaining duration rather than a process-local absolute clock, includes admitted execution, retry backoff, serialization, and storage work, excludes human approval wait and wall-clock downtime, and refuses expired or rollback observations before new work.

Reservation acquires active-runtime, provider-attempt, tool-attempt, retry-attempt, external-cost, provider-output, tool-input, tool-output, artifact, run-byte, and concurrency-slot resources as one immutable state transition and one revision CAS in a fixed canonical resource order.

Reservation admission includes already used resources and every active reservation, applies per-value byte caps and cumulative run/cost/runtime/attempt caps, never oversubscribes a slot or resource, and does not leave a partial permit when any unit is denied.

Settlement records actual usage, unused release, result/effect evidence hashes, status, cancellation evidence, and the exact permit and operation lineage once; exact replay returns the recorded settlement without invoking the effect, while payload mismatch is an idempotency conflict.

Actual usage exceeding its reservation records the observed usage, latches a settlement_overrun failure, closes the permit conservatively, and refuses all new work; it is never truncated to the reservation or reported as success.

A reservation committed before effect start remains reserved after restart and may be released only by an explicit exact-idempotent no-effect reconciliation; a started but unsettled effect becomes effect_unknown/reconciliation_required and cannot be automatically released, retried, or reported as success.

Revision CAS conflicts, run locks, current-replace ambiguity, durability uncertainty, and effect-unknown storage outcomes have distinct typed results; only verified mutation-zero internal control conflicts are retry candidates, and external effects are never blindly retried.

Retry admission remains separate from execution, accepts only explicitly transient and idempotent or authoritatively reconcilable effects, refuses validation, policy, budget, deadline, cancellation, deterministic-tool failure, unsupported, unavailable, verification, unknown-effect, and unconfirmed-effect cases, and enforces at most N+1 attempts for N approved retries.

Every retry has a fresh attempt ID and fresh ContextEnvelope with a fresh context ID, parent attempt/context lineage, preserved root lineage and source hash, revalidated expiry/classification/assignment allowlist and blind-isolation invariants, and no mutable context reuse; persisted budget state contains only permitted scalar hashes and provenance, never raw provider/tool context or secret values.

Every permit and attempt has typed owner kind, owner ID, role, phase ID, assignment ID where applicable, root/parent attempt and context IDs, execution ordinal, and idempotency lineage; ownership substitution, cross-role context reuse, shared mutable state, and unbounded fan-out fail closed.

The opt-in bounded executor reserves before start, starts only admitted work, assigns unique deterministic execution ordinals, reduces results, tool ordinals, evidence order, and reproduction metadata by ordinal rather than completion or dictionary order, records actual peak concurrency, and settles or explicitly marks every acquired permit.

Cancellation distinguishes not_requested, requested, acknowledged, cancelled, unconfirmed, and effect_unknown; fan-out addresses every in-flight permit, cancellation is success only after acknowledged cooperative completion, and a live/unconfirmed worker prevents successful terminal interpretation.

The RM-028 interface carries typed isolation and external-effect evidence and refuses any hard-stop claim without RM-028 evidence; P2-011B does not implement process-tree termination, remote kill, OS resource isolation, or an external provider/solver.

A deterministic calculator settlement binds exact ToolRequest/ToolResult bytes, request/result hashes, execution ordinal, contract version, and reproduction metadata; exact replay returns the durable settlement and does not rerun, double-charge, double-settle, or reorder the calculator.

Context, multi-agent control, calculator/tool, architecture, security, fault, Windows, roadmap, approval, and Git reviews each report High, Medium, and Low counts; all High and Medium findings are remediated and each Low is fixed or receives a concrete recorded risk acceptance.

Crash/fault tests cover before and after reservation, effect start, settlement, release, current replace, and response; replay tests cover current and historical settlements; concurrency tests cover same-process and separate-store writers, CAS conflict, duplicate keys, stable ordering, cancellation/commit races, and permit leaks.

Windows tests preserve P2-012A link/reparse/hardlink, lock identity, atomic replace, file sync, supported directory sync, and directory-sync-unavailable evidence; P2-011B does not upgrade unavailable directory sync to confirmed power-loss durability.

The ordinary Orchestrator constructor, run, resume, load_report, CLI commands and exit codes, flat-v1 artifact order and meanings, state-machine snapshot, provider/tool call order, existing golden output, and P2-010B/P2-012A structural behavior remain unchanged.

Capability states do not change: parallel_deliberation_and_tool_retry remains disabled for the ordinary product path, process_sandbox remains unavailable, immutable_revision_storage_foundation remains implemented, and product_integrated_durable_run remains planned; doctor and documentation explain the internal-only P2-011B boundary without overclaim.

No external provider, external solver, package installation, external code execution, network send, completion marker, verified product status, flat-v1 migration, ordinary run/resume integration, terminal product run, lifecycle hook, approval CAS, cleanup, encryption, hard stop, PR, merge, tag, or release is added.

Candidate and final gates pass on their respective exact HEADs with the digest-bound approved suite, full pytest suite, ruff check, ruff format check, mypy, roadmap generation/check/require-tracked, doctor JSON, management JSON/JSONL parsing, public-preflight/history guard, ignore/nonstage/clean guard, git diff check, and four independent framework reviews.

Only real implementation and remediation commits are completion evidence; approval, scope-freeze, scaffold-only, implementation-start, and completion-evidence commits are excluded from the ordered implementation commit list.

Completion changes P2-011B and RM-011 to completed only after candidate evidence passes, while P2-012B approval remains null, state remains not_started, evidence remains empty, product_integrated_durable_run remains planned, and the generated roadmap document is updated.
After P2-011B completion, ignored management data records P2-012B only as the proposal-only next candidate with approval null, not_started state, and no implementation or evidence.

After the completion-evidence commit, the exact final HEAD passes the complete final gate again, is pushed non-force only to origin/codex/phase2-durable-budget-integration, and ends with local HEAD equal to upstream, ahead/behind 0/0, tracked worktree clean, index empty, and ignored management data untracked and unpushed.

policy_decisions: Implement canonical milestone P2-011B and complete RM-011 only; do not implement P2-012B, P2-013A/B, P2-027B, P2-028A, PR, merge, tag, or release.

Treat the verified baseline codex/phase2-phase-durable-integration at 8e52c6aec1c7152dfe0c2e8d92dd467f39c7132f, upstream 0/0, clean tracked/index state, and exact configured origin URL as the only permitted branch base; remote freshness remains UNKNOWN because fetch is prohibited.

After explicit approval and before implementation, revalidate the exact baseline and create codex/phase2-durable-budget-integration; do not fetch, pull, rebase, reset, amend, force-push, or rewrite history.

This exact JSON object is the entire normative approval scope under roadmap approval schema 1.1.0; do not calculate or record its canonical digest before explicit human approval, and require a full revised proposal and new approval for any target, test, criterion, policy, schema, or wording change.

No separate roadmap-governance amendment is required: P2-011B already exists in the canonical milestone DAG with completed dependency P2-012A, and the existing 1.1.0 scoped-approval machinery admits this exact milestone scope.

Use a separate explicitly initialized internal structural revision root for P2-011B budget state; do not share the flat-v1 product runs root or the P2-010B phase-revision root, and do not infer product completion or product resumability from this root.

Use producer_id p2-011b-durable-budget, producer_version 0.1.0, storage protocol poker-run-revision-v1, durable contract schema 1.0.0, and artifact schema poker-durable-budget-state-artifact-v1; leave existing storage, budget 2.0.0, phase, context, tool, and product artifact versions unchanged.

Add budget_state.json as a strict internal RUN_AUDIT/local-data artifact with default internal classification; persist typed hashes, IDs, units, statuses, and provenance only, never raw ContextEnvelope payload, provider input, tool context, secret, credential, exception, traceback, or mutable object.

Add one internal durable policy that wraps the exact existing BudgetPolicyV2 value and a versioned execution activation; do not alter BudgetPolicyV2 defaults, config migration, SerialUsageLedger, phase request/outcome schema, or ordinary serialized behavior.

The execution activation defaults to max_concurrent_agents=1 and max_automatic_retries=0; this approval authorizes internal testable opt-in bounded concurrency from 1 through 32 and automatic retries only up to the existing strict max_tool_retries value, but authorizes no ordinary product activation.

Use the canonical resource order active_runtime_ns, provider_attempts, tool_attempts, retry_attempts, external_cost_micro_usd, provider_output_bytes, tool_input_bytes, tool_output_bytes, artifact_bytes, run_bytes, concurrency_slots for validation, reservation, settlement, release, hashing, and deterministic reports.

Treat provider/tool/output/artifact byte reservations as exact non-negative UTF-8 byte upper bounds per admitted effect and treat run bytes, runtime, external cost, attempts, retries, and slots as cumulative or active resources as defined by the durable model; P2-012A physical revision-root byte admission remains an independent stricter filesystem cap.

Require external-cost reservations and settlements to use integer micro-USD; unknown estimates, zero external-cost caps, unauthenticated actuals, actuals above reservation, and unavailable external execution fail closed before or at settlement, while verified local-free execution remains cost zero.

Do not claim provider invoice metering: P2-011B verifies strict caller-supplied estimate and actual unit values plus idempotency/effect evidence, and external provider enablement or billing-source verification requires a later separately approved integration.

Represent durable state as immutable full snapshots chained by previous_state_sha256 and P2-012A manifest/revision lineage; retain prior revisions and never compact, delete, quarantine, rewrite, or auto-adopt an orphan.

Expose only an internal structural artifact-history read that reuses P2-012A chain and payload verification; do not export it from poker_deliberation.storage package root and do not map it to completed, failed, resumable, terminal, or migrated product status.

Make every mutation a caller-visible exact-idempotent operation with operation_id and canonical request SHA-256; exact replay returns the recorded outcome, while key reuse with different bytes is idempotency_conflict.

Acquire every resource and its concurrency slot in one immutable successor state and one revision CAS; never hold a slot while waiting for a separately acquired budget resource, and never publish a partial reservation.

Reserve before effect start, mark effect start durably before accepting a side-effecting result, and settle actual usage exactly once; release only verified unused reservation and never reduce already settled usage.

If actual usage exceeds a reservation, record the observed actual value, settlement_overrun, and a durable fail-closed latch; refuse new permits and require explicit reconciliation rather than truncating, rolling back, or reporting success.

On restart, leave committed not-started reservations intact until explicit no-effect release, and convert or reconcile started-unsettled work only to effect_unknown/reconciliation_required unless authoritative effect evidence proves a unique settlement.

Allow a durable policy change only through an exact-idempotent monotonic-tightening operation that records old/new canonical hashes and a non-secret reason hash; reject loosening, concurrency/retry activation increases, values below used plus active reservations, and in-place history edits.

Use injected monotonic nanoseconds for active runtime, persist accumulated duration and remaining budget rather than process-local absolute timestamps, include admitted effect work, deterministic retry backoff, serialization, and storage boundaries, exclude human approval wait and restart downtime, and fail closed on rollback or expiry.

Bind each permit and attempt to typed owner_kind, owner_id, role, phase_id, optional assignment_id, root_attempt_id, parent_attempt_id, root_context_id, parent_context_id, execution_ordinal, and idempotency key/hash; reject missing ownership, cross-owner substitution, duplicate ordinal, and mutable shared execution state.

Separate failure classification, retry admission, attempt construction, execution, and settlement; internal control CAS may be retried only after a fresh verified read and only when mutation/effect is proven absent, while effect execution follows the stricter retry contract.

Allow retry only for explicitly transient provider/tool failures with idempotent or authoritative reconcilable effects; refuse automatic retry for validation, security, policy, approval, unsupported, unavailable, budget, deadline, cancellation, deterministic-tool failure, verification, non-convergence, effect_unknown, and cancel-unconfirmed states.

Create a fresh attempt ID and fresh ContextEnvelope for every retry through the existing context lifecycle contract, preserve root/parent attempt and context lineage, and reject reused mutable context or mismatched source/policy/envelope hashes.

Revalidate retry context expiry, classification, assignment allowlist parity, run/assignment lineage, source/root lineage, envelope integrity, and blind isolation before every admitted retry; persist only context IDs and approved hashes/provenance, keep attempt-memory-only-v1 authoritative, and add no context persistence or cleanup.

The bounded executor is an internal callable adapter, not a provider/runtime bridge; it reserves in deterministic input order, starts admitted callables only, assigns stable execution ordinals, reduces results/tool ordinals/evidence/reproduction metadata by ordinal, uses no shared mutable payload state, and records peak concurrency independently of completion timing.

Fan cancellation out to every in-flight cooperative token, persist requested and acknowledgment states separately, wait only the approved bounded grace supplied to the internal executor, and record a still-live or unconfirmed worker as cancel_unconfirmed/effect_unknown rather than success or hard stop.

Define a typed RM-028 boundary/evidence interface but ship no RM-028 implementation; any request that requires process-tree kill, remote cancellation guarantee, OS CPU/memory/output enforcement, or external-code isolation returns isolation_required before execution.

Bind deterministic calculator settlements to exact ToolRequest and ToolResult bytes, execution ordinal, contract version, result hash, and reproduction metadata hash; exact settlement replay bypasses the callable so successful deterministic work is not rerun or double-accounted.
Preserve external_solver=unavailable and do not assert GTO, equilibrium, exploitability, or exact ranges without a separately executed and convergence-verified solver.

Fault semantics are: crash before reservation commit leaves no domain reservation; after reservation/before start leaves an explicit releasable reservation; after start/before settlement is effect_unknown; before settlement CAS leaves the prior state; after ambiguous current replace requires reread/reconciliation; after committed settlement/before response is exact-idempotent replay.

Cancellation/commit race semantics are: a settlement committed before cancellation remains authoritative; cancellation committed before effect start prevents start; acknowledged cancellation without settlement remains non-success; unconfirmed cancellation latches effect_unknown and blocks retry.

Concurrent writer semantics are: the P2-012A run authority and expected revision/manifest/pointer CAS select one winner, losers return run_locked or cas_conflict without lost update, and exact replay after winner publication returns the unique recorded operation outcome.

Windows semantics inherit P2-012A exact path confinement, reparse/hardlink rejection, byte-range locking, verified atomic replace, file sync, and directory-sync evidence; unavailable directory sync remains unavailable evidence and is not upgraded to confirmed durability.

Capability matrix states are unchanged: ordinary parallel_deliberation_and_tool_retry stays disabled, process_sandbox stays unavailable, immutable_revision_storage_foundation stays implemented, and product_integrated_durable_run stays planned; roadmap and docs describe the new internal-only P2-011B contract.

The behavioral test edit allowlist is exactly the first twelve test paths in milestone_implementation_scope.tests: the ten new durable-budget test files, tests/integration/test_roadmap_status.py, and tests/unit/test_local_data_policy.py.

Every test path after the first twelve is execute-only regression coverage; do not edit, delete, skip, weaken, monkeypatch away, or replace its existing assertions without a revised full proposal and new explicit approval.

At scope freeze, add only nonbehavioral tracked scaffolds for the three new production modules and ten new test files so --require-tracked can validate this exact scope; scaffold-only content is not implementation evidence.
Change and stage only exact approved target paths and behavioral test allowlist paths; never use git add ., git add -A, or git add -f, and verify the index before every commit.

Commit in auditable units: exact scope freeze/scaffolds; implementation-start roadmap transition; strict durable models; structural artifact admission/history read; durable reservation/CAS/settlement; bounded retry/concurrency/cancellation/RM-028 interface; review remediation/docs; completion evidence.

Exclude approval, scope-freeze, scaffold-only, implementation-start, and completion-evidence commits from implementation evidence; include only real implementation and remediation commits in chronological order.

The digest-bound approved suite command loads milestone_implementation_scope.tests from this exact proposal after verifying its approved canonical digest, then runs all listed paths with .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest; the full suite command is .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest.

Candidate and final static/generator commands are .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check ., .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format --check ., .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m mypy src, .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\generate_roadmap_status.py, .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\generate_roadmap_status.py --check --require-tracked, and .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m poker_deliberation doctor --format json.

Candidate and final governance commands include management JSON/JSONL strict parsing, git diff --check, .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\public_preflight.py --format json, all-commit approved-path/history verification, git check-ignore, git ls-files, git diff --cached, and git status porcelain checks.

Perform four independent review records on the same candidate/final HEAD: Context framework; Multi-agent control framework; Math/tool/solver framework; Architecture/security/fault/governance. Remediate every High and Medium; fix each Low or record a concrete risk acceptance, then rerun affected gates and reviews.

After candidate gates and reviews pass, update only P2-011B and RM-011 to completed with exact ordered implementation commits/paths/tests, keep P2-012B approval null/not_started/evidence empty, regenerate docs/roadmap-status.md, and create a dedicated completion-evidence commit.

After P2-011B completion, write P2-012B only to ignored next-session-recommendation management data as a proposal-only next candidate with approval null, state not_started, and empty evidence; do not create a P2-012B tracked proposal, digest, branch, scaffold, or implementation.

After the completion-evidence commit, rerun the complete candidate gate and four reviews on the exact final HEAD; any finding or failure requires remediation, corrected evidence, a new final HEAD, and another complete final cycle.

Keep tmp management data, proposal, decisions, risk register, checks, reviews, test output, caches, run artifacts, PLAN/PROGRESS, and user_materials ignored, untracked, unstaged, uncommitted, unpushed, untransmitted, and not auto-deleted.

Push only after exact final gates pass and only if git remote get-url origin exactly equals https://github.com/guriguri215-lang/poker-deliberation-framework.git; use non-force git push -u origin codex/phase2-durable-budget-integration and never force-push.

After push verify local HEAD equals upstream HEAD, ahead/behind is 0/0, tracked worktree is clean, index is empty, and this ignored management directory remains untracked and unpushed; do not create a PR, merge, tag, or release.

goal-rm013-p2-013a-2026-07-25.source_label: explicit human approval of the entire P2-013A exact proposal in the Codex task
topics: PD-01 Scope boundary: implement only P2-013A actor, authority, canonical action digest, request/decision idempotency, all-or-nothing validation, strict ledger reading, bounded failure audit, RM-012 CAS transaction, structured error, CLI/API compatibility, and external binding interface. Do not implement P2-013B lifecycle/reissue integration, P2-027B cleanup execution, P2-028A isolation, an external provider/solver/executor, retry/parallel scheduling, or any unrelated capability transition.

PD-02 Canonical state boundary: start from codex/phase2-product-durable-run at exact HEAD 2c353155aadb557fa667939510e356ca5996b41a with origin/codex/phase2-product-durable-run ahead/behind 0/0 and a clean tracked worktree/index. After approval create codex/phase2-approval-authority-contracts without fetch, pull, reset, rebase, amend, merge, or history rewrite.

PD-03 Exact target classification: approval_models.py, approval_canonical.py, and docs/approval-authority-contract.md are planned new tracked files. Every other milestone target exists and is edit-allowed only for this scope. schemas.py, reporting/markdown.py, security.py, storage/legacy_migration.py, storage revision V1 models/canonical/store/lock, and every other unlisted production path are execute-only compatibility surfaces and must remain byte-unchanged. No other production, phase, storage, schema, CLI, roadmap, documentation, dependency, workflow, user_materials, run-artifact, or management path is edit-authorized without a revised proposal and new explicit approval.

PD-04 Exact test classification: the first eight milestone tests are planned new tracked tests. test_state_storage_approval.py, test_phase_contracts.py, test_pure_phase_services.py, test_phase_properties.py, test_phase_orchestration.py, test_phase_boundaries.py, test_phase_failures.py, test_product_durable_run.py, test_cli.py, test_product_run_compatibility.py, test_security_behavior.py, test_review_regressions.py, test_budget_orchestration.py, and test_roadmap_status.py are edit-allowed only to preserve or strengthen the approved contract. Every remaining listed test is execute-only compatibility evidence; no assertion may be deleted, weakened, skipped, or xfailed.

PD-05 Schema and canonicalization: V2 approval values use schema_version 2.0.0, strict frozen extra-forbid Pydantic models, exact timezone-aware UTC, NFC strings, finite numeric limits, bounded lengths/counts, UTF-8 without BOM, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, compact separators, duplicate-key rejection, lowercase SHA-256, and a different explicit hash domain for every action, request, actor, batch, decision, outcome, audit, ledger, and external binding.

PD-06 Actor identity: ApprovalActor contains actor_id, actor_type, authority_source, authority_scopes, verification_status, verification_reference_sha256, session_reference_sha256, credential_reference_sha256, verified_at, authority_expires_at, and revocation_status. Raw session IDs, credentials, tokens, certificates, provider payloads, and unrestricted identity claims are never persisted.

PD-07 Trust model: DecisionAuthorityProvider is an injected local protocol whose returned canonical actor snapshot is trusted only within the process boundary. The default LocalCliAuthorityProvider returns verification_status=unverified, authority_source=local_cli, and only reject:any. P2-013A ships no external authority provider, performs no network verification, and makes no authentication claim for self-reported local actor text.

PD-08 Authority scopes: the closed taxonomy is reject:any plus approve:<action_category> for each existing ApprovalCategory. Reject requires reject:any and is permitted to the unverified local interactive actor as a safe-side operation. Approve requires a provider-verified actor, exact approve category scope, nonexpired authority, and revocation_status=not_revoked; wildcard approve, inferred scope, category coercion, and self-declared verification are forbidden.

PD-09 Actor spoof handling: a V2 batch carries a canonical claimed ApprovalActor snapshot for binding, but the transaction independently resolves the actor through DecisionAuthorityProvider. Any mismatch in actor ID/type/source/scope/status/reference/timestamps/revocation is actor_spoof. A canonical unverified actor attempting approve is unauthorized_decision. Both produce domain mutation zero and require a confirmed bounded security-audit event.

PD-10 Canonical action plan: CanonicalActionPlanV2 has exact operation, action category, executor kind/identifier/version/SHA-256/availability, ordered outbound field name/classification/content-SHA-256 bindings, exact destination kind/identifier, retention policy ID, trace policy ID, maximum cost/runtime/memory/output/process counts, working directory, ordered environment-name allowlist, expected result type, execution ID, remote idempotency key, and UTC expiry. It stores no raw outbound content or environment values.

PD-11 Action digest domain: action_digest_sha256 is SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 bytes under poker-approval-action-plan-v2. Any plan field, ordering, version, hash, destination, policy, limit, directory, environment, expected result, execution identity, idempotency identity, or expiry change makes the approval stale and requires a new request. Approval never binds a different executable or future substitute by name similarity.

PD-12 Request creation: ApprovalRequestV2 contains request_id, request_revision, ledger_revision, created_run_revision, action plan/digest, requested display fields, required authority scope, created_at, expires_at, source phase/attempt lineage, request idempotency key, state, and supersession reference. The key is derived from run ID, phase ID, stable proposal ID, action category, and action digest; attempt ID is recorded but excluded. Same key/same payload returns the same pending request, same key/different payload conflicts, and replacement requires first committing the old request as superseded.

PD-13 Input proposal boundary: metadata.approval_requests remains accepted. Objects without schema_version remain V1 proposals and cannot supply decision/actor/revision/digest fields. Exact schema_version 2.0.0 objects parse as ApprovalProposalV2 and may supply only proposal and canonical action-plan inputs; request IDs/revisions, status, decision, authority, actor verification, audit, and outcome are application-owned. Unknown versions and injected decision fields fail closed or are explicitly ignored with a security/data-quality event as the current safe behavior requires.

PD-14 V1 historical boundary: existing ApprovalRequest V1 and approvals.json remain readable for reports and immutable prior revisions. A strict HistoricalApprovalV1Binding may bind the exact canonical V1 bytes for rejection-only compatibility and create a V2 decision record; it is never an actionable ApprovalRequestV2, never gains an inferred action plan/authority/digest, and cannot be approved, renewed, repaired, or silently migrated. Full legacy reissue belongs to P2-013B.

PD-15 Authoritative artifacts: new approval checkpoints contain approval_ledger_v2.json, approval_decisions_v2.jsonl, approval_audit_v2.jsonl, and the existing approvals.json compatibility projection. The V2 ledger owns ledger_revision and ordered requests; decision and audit logs are append-only canonical chains with sequence, previous hash, and head hash. FinalReport.approvals and approvals.json remain exact ApprovalRequest V1 projections with no new fields; strict version dispatch applies to the separate authoritative V2 artifacts, and terminal validation requires the V1 projection to exactly match the authoritative V2 state.

PD-16 Batch schema: ApprovalDecisionBatch binds schema version, run ID, expected run revision, expected ledger revision, canonical claimed actor, decision ID, idempotency key, ordered decision items, bounded redacted reason, and client decision time. Each item binds request ID, expected request revision, exact action digest, and one decision approved or rejected. Batch payload SHA-256 includes every field and canonical item order.

PD-17 Fixed validation order: validate strict current and every ledger/log chain before lookup; resolve idempotency key; compare saved actor and payload hashes; return exact saved outcome on same replay; reject different replay; only for a new key check expected run then ledger revision; validate decision-ID and request-ID uniqueness; distinguish duplicate from approve+reject; check unknown/already-decided/request revision/action digest/expiry; resolve and compare trusted actor; verify exact scopes; reverify authority in-lock; then publish. No later error may mask an earlier category in this order.

PD-18 Failure taxonomy: closed codes are approval_unknown, approval_duplicate, approval_already_decided, approval_expired, approval_ledger_corrupt, legacy_approval_historical_only, actor_spoof, unauthorized_decision, authority_revoked, stale_decision, approve_reject_conflict, idempotency_conflict, action_digest_mismatch, resume_conflict, resume_transaction_failed, external_executor_unavailable, audit_rate_limited, audit_capacity_exceeded, and audit_unconfirmed. Failures are redacted typed values, never tracebacks or success, and automatic retry is false except an explicitly surfaced RM-012 run_locked condition.

PD-19 Decision idempotency: decision ID and idempotency key are both unique in a strict log. Same key plus byte-equivalent actor and batch payload returns the exact persisted ApprovalDecisionOutcome even after terminal publication and performs zero write. Same key or decision ID with different data is idempotency_conflict. Different keys aimed at an already decided request are approval_already_decided, not last-write-wins.

PD-20 CAS transaction: construct all successor payloads from one VerifiedRunReadV2 snapshot in memory and invoke TerminalRunStore with expected revision, manifest hash, and current-pointer hash. Use a deterministic transaction ID derived from run ID, decision idempotency key, and batch hash. RM-012 nonblocking authority and current CAS select one winner. On conflict reread only for exact replay; otherwise return stale_decision/resume_conflict and append a failure audit without modifying the winner.

PD-21 Domain atomicity: all request statuses, ledger revision, decision outcome, domain audit event, state snapshot, JSON/Markdown report, manifest lineage, completion marker when terminal, and current pointer refer to the same decision/batch hashes and revision. Pending remains approval_required, all reject reaches the existing safe completed path, and any approve reaches failed_with_limitations because no executor exists. Partial batch, mixed old/new report, and mixed winner artifacts are forbidden.

PD-22 Failure audit: successful approve/reject is audited inside the immutable domain revision. Every validation/authorization/conflict failure attempts one separate redacted control-ledger event by audit_sequence CAS under the same per-run authority while leaving the domain current unchanged. The event contains hashes/IDs and observed revisions, never raw reason, action content, credential, traceback, or secret. AC-04: Every new actionable request has an exact action digest, request revision, ledger revision, created run revision, required authority scope, UTC expiry, and deterministic request idempotency binding derived from run/phase/action identity with attempt ID recorded as lineage but excluded from the key; a changed plan cannot reuse approval and requires an explicit superseding request.

AC-05: A trusted injected DecisionAuthorityProvider is the only source of verified authority; the default local CLI provider is unverified, persists only hashed session/credential references, may reject any pending action, and may not approve an external or destructive action. AC-06: The strict ledger reader rejects unknown versions, duplicate request IDs, duplicate decision IDs or idempotency keys, malformed transitions, invalid timestamps, broken action digests, noncanonical ordering, log truncation, and head-hash mismatch before constructing lookup dictionaries or changing state.

AC-07: Decision validation is all-or-nothing and follows the fixed order: strict current/ledger/log read; idempotency-key lookup; saved actor and payload-hash comparison; exact replay return; expected run revision; expected ledger revision; batch decision-ID and request-ID uniqueness; approve+reject conflict; unknown/already-decided/request-revision/action-digest/expiry checks; trusted actor verification; authority scope; second in-lock authority verification; then publication.

AC-08: Same idempotency key plus the exact canonical actor and payload returns the previously persisted ApprovalDecisionOutcome without artifact, audit, report, state, manifest, marker, or pointer rewrite; the same key with any different canonical payload or actor fails idempotency_conflict. A terminal run performs this replay check before returning its report and never silently ignores an opposite decision.

AC-09: A new decision builds ledger, decision log, domain audit event, compatibility projection, state, JSON report, and Markdown report entirely in memory from one verified current revision, then publishes one immutable successor with RM-012 lock and exact current-pointer CAS. AC-10: Successful approve or reject decisions are recorded in the domain revision with the exact decision/outcome/audit hashes. Unknown, stale, duplicate, conflicting, unauthorized, spoofed, expired, tampered, or CAS-losing attempts leave the domain current revision unchanged and append one bounded redacted security-audit control event by audit_sequence CAS; if that audit cannot be confirmed, the result is audit_unconfirmed and no decision revision is advanced.

AC-11: The security-audit control ledger stores immutable canonical events with a current sequence/hash pointer under the same RM-012 per-run authority, permits at most 1024 events, 16384 bytes per event, and 1048576 bytes per run, and permits at most 32 failed-attempt events per actor/run in a rolling 60-second UTC window. item_contract.title: Local data lifecycle
item_contract.objective: Define a versioned local-data classification, retention, expiry, quarantine, disposition, encryption, failure, and audit contract in P2-027A, then add authorized filesystem enforcement only in separately approved P2-027B.
acceptance_criteria: P2-027A provides a strict versioned immutable policy and pure evaluation contract with approved classification mapping, exact retention and expiry semantics, quarantine and disposition candidates, encryption requirements, typed non-retryable failures, canonical hashes, and bounded audit metadata without filesystem mutation.

P2-027A preserves ContextPolicy and ContextEnvelope 1.0.0, attempt-memory-only-v1, existing provider/orchestrator/storage/CLI behavior, blind isolation, tool contracts, exactness, and evidence provenance.

P2-027B remains separately approval-gated after P2-012B and P2-013A and requires verified ownership, active/pending protection, actor authority, approved dry-run action digest, revision CAS, receipts/tombstones, idempotency, and partial-failure reconciliation without claiming secure erase absent platform evidence.

relations: P2-027B follows P2-012B and P2-013A and is not approved by the P2-027A scope.

AC-07: CleanupPlanV1 は exactly one action、schema/policy/executor identity、source/destination root identity、relative paths、tree inventory digest、current revision/manifest/pointer、lifecycle/audit/hold evidence、quarantine/delete eligibility、limits、generated/expires UTC、execution/idempotency identityを拘束する。どの field、順序、byte、root identity、tree、時刻、policy、executorが変わっても digest が変わる。

AC-08: P2-013A CanonicalActionPlanV2 は action category destructive_change、executor kind local_process、exact installed cleanup module inventory SHA-256、cleanup plan SHA-256、cleanup-root identity、policy/trace IDs、resource bounds、result type、execution ID、idempotency key、expiryを拘束する。raw content、environment value、credential、token、absolute path は保存しない。

AC-11: P2-012A と同じ process registry + nonblocking kernel per-run authority を public bounded seam から再利用し、lock 内で root ownership、case/NFC alias、product current revision/manifest/pointer、cleanup current revision/pointer、tree digest、hold/pending/expiry/authority/action digest を再検証してから唯一の rename または staged delete 境界へ進む。

AC-12: cleanup control state は immutable transaction/revision と atomic current pointer CAS を持ち、quarantined -> delete_prepared -> deleted のみを許す。stale plan、stale product pointer、stale cleanup pointer、別 transaction、別 plan/key は last-write-wins せず fail closed になる。

AC-19: CleanupLimitsV1 は1 plan/1 action、最大10000 tree entries、100000000 target bytes、1000000 control artifact bytes、10000000 control bytes/run、最大24時間 plan lifetime を既定上限として action digest に拘束する。上限、空き容量、control audit/receipt reservation の事前検査に失敗した場合は mutation zero、effect 後の exhaustion は reconciliation_required とする。

AC-20: cooperative cancellation は lock前、journal前、filesystem effect直前に確認し、effect前は mutation zero で停止する。effect開始後の cancellation は undo や process hard-stop を主張せず、観測済み state に応じて committed result または reconciliation_required を返す。

AC-21: public Python surface は LocalDataCleanupExecutor、initialize/inspect cleanup root、dry_run_quarantine、dry_run_delete、execute、inspect_reconciliation と strict models/results を additive module API として提供する。Orchestrator constructor/run/resume/show/load_report/report_path、AppConfig、RunStore、CLI command/exit code は変更せず、cleanup CLI は追加しない。

PD-09 Conservative two-stage lifecycle: verified product runを直接deleteしない。exact product currentを同一volume quarantineへatomic renameし、tombstone/receiptを確定する。quarantine_entered_atから固定30日後に改めてdry-runとdestructive approvalを得た場合だけstaged deleteを行う。

PD-10 Cleanup root ownership: explicit initialize操作で専用root markerを作り、product root ownership marker hash、resolved root identity、producer/version、canonicalization/hash、limitsをbindする。product/legacy/cleanup rootsのoverlap、link/reparse、case/NFC alias、cross-volume quarantineを拒否し、dry-runはrootを自動作成しない。

PD-11 Exact plan: CleanupPlanV1はexactly one ordered actionとし、root/tree/current/manifest/pointer/lifecycle/audit/hold/policy/executor/limit/time/execution/idempotency identityを含む。plan fieldまたはcanonical orderの変更は別digest・別承認を必要とする。

PD-12 P2-013A action binding: CanonicalActionPlanV2はdestructive_change、local_process、exact installed cleanup module inventory hash、plan digest、cleanup-root identity、p2-027a retention policy、p2-027b trace policy、resource上限、result type、execution/idempotency identity、expiryをbindする。outbound network dataはなく、planのinternal digestだけをfield bindingに含める。

PD-13 Approval evidence: executeはverified approval runのcurrent ledger/decision chainからapproved requestとcommitted outcomeを選び、request/result revision、action digest、decision/outcome/record hashes、actor/authority snapshotを照合する。P2-013Aのexternal_executor_unavailableはapproval時にeffect未実行だったことを示すだけでcleanup outcomeには転用しない。

PD-14 Pre-effect authority: injected DecisionAuthorityProviderをexecution時とfilesystem effect直前のrun lock内で再解決し、stored actor/provider ID/version、verified、approve:destructive_change、not_revoked、authority expiry、request/plan expiryを完全一致で確認する。一般reissue/renewal/resume lifecycleはP2-013Bに残す。

PD-15 Legal hold evidence: injected versioned legal-hold providerのcanonical snapshotとreference hashをplanへbindし、dry-runとeffect直前に再解決する。provider unavailable、identity/version change、hold true、snapshot mismatchはaction zeroとする。

PD-16 Authority and CAS: storage/revision_store.pyには既存run専用のbounded public authority acquisition seamだけを追加し、既存process registry/kernel nonblocking lock、ownership、alias検証を再利用する。cleanupはlock内でproduct current CASとcleanup current revision/pointer CASを再検査しlast-write-winsを禁止する。

PD-17 Quarantine transition: pre-effect immutable transactionにplan/approval/source identitiesを保存・rereadした後、resolved product run directoryをexact quarantine destinationへsingle same-volume renameする。成功後にreceipt/tombstone/revision/current pointerをcanonical publishし、source absent/destination exactをrereadする。

PD-18 Delete transition: quarantine current/tombstone、30日expiry、tree inventory、hold、authority、approval、cleanup pointer CASを再確認し、quarantine payloadをtransaction-specific deleting stagingへrenameしてからnon-following bottom-up unlinkする。product runからのdirect recursive deleteは提供しない。

PD-19 Receipt and tombstone: receiptはaction result、plan/approval/actor/authority/tree/effect/timestamps/durability evidenceを、tombstoneはoriginal current identity、quarantine/delete state、receipt hash、365日保持期限をbindする。control evidenceはこのexecutor自身のcleanup対象にせず自動truncate/overwriteしない。

PD-20 Idempotency: exact same execution ID/idempotency key/plan/approvalでcompleted currentが存在すればexact persisted resultをwrite zeroで返す。same key/different canonical data、different key/same stale current、opposite actionはidempotency_conflictまたはstale_cleanup_revisionとする。

PD-21 Crash and partial failure: effect前faultはmutation zero、rename後またはpartial unlink後のwrite/fsync/pointer/cancellation faultはsuccessを返さずreconciliation_requiredとする。source/destination/staging/receipt/tombstone/currentの組合せが一意に確定できなければeffect_unknownで停止し、自動retryや推測repairを行わない。

PD-22 Filesystem security: portable ASCII IDsとfixed relative grammarだけを許可し、absolute/drive/URI/ADS、reserved device、traversal、case/NFC alias、symlink、junction/reparse、hardlink、unknown namespace、root escape、cross-volume copy fallbackを拒否する。全componentとtreeをlstat/statし、effect直前にresolved absolute targetを再確認する。

PD-23 Durability truthfulness: file fsync、canonical reread、atomic replace/rename、platformが許すdirectory syncをevidence化する。Windows directory fsync、power-loss durability、same-privilege writer authenticity、network/distributed filesystem atomicity、exactly-once、secure eraseは保証しない。

PD-24 Failure and retry: closed failure taxonomyはacceptance criteria AC-18の通りとし、run_lockedだけsemantic retryable=trueを許すがautomatic_retry_allowedは常にfalseとする。failureはfixed bounded code、hashed identity、effect/reconciliation stateだけを返しraw path/content/exception/traceback/secretを返さない。

PD-25 Capacity and cancellation: CleanupLimitsV1の既定は1 action、10000 entries、100000000 target bytes、1000000 control artifact bytes、10000000 control bytes/run、最大24時間plan lifetimeとする。cooperative tokenはhard stopでなく、effect前cancelはzero、effect後cancelはobserved resultまたはreconciliationを返す。

PD-26 API and CLI: additive Python module APIだけを提供し、LocalDataCleanupExecutor、root initialize/inspect、dry_run_quarantine、dry_run_delete、execute、inspect_reconciliationを公開する。Orchestrator/AppConfig/RunStore/root package exports/CLI/signatures/exit codesを変更せず、verified authorityを安全に取得できない既定CLIへcleanup commandを追加しない。

PD-27 Secret boundary: plan/control/auditはbounded ID、relative logical path、classification、size/count、domain-separated hashだけを保存する。raw payload、ContextEnvelope、provider input、approval reason、credential/token/certificate、environment value、unrestricted absolute path、exception/tracebackは保存しない。

PD-28 Non-regression: P2-027A policy values、P2-012B terminal protocol、P2-013A decision semantics、ContextPolicy/ContextEnvelope 1.0.0、attempt-memory-only-v1、serial provider/tool ordering、automatic retry 0、ToolResult exactness、reproduction metadata、solver_status、blind isolationを変更しない。solver実行なしにGTO/均衡/exact range/exploitabilityを主張しない。

PD-29 Test plan: new unit/property/integration/adversarial/fault/concurrency/characterization suitesで全schema/digest/state/authority/CAS/effect/fault/security/capacity/cancellation/replay境界をdisposable temp rootsのみで検証し、milestone test listの既存policy/storage/approval/context/tool/golden/CLI testsをexecute-only regression evidenceとして再実行する。

PD-30 Safe commit units: approval後は(1) approval record/scope digest/roadmap in_progressとroadmap test、(2) strict models/canonical/dry-run pure eligibility、(3) cleanup root/store/quarantineとsecurity tests、(4) approval binding/delete/idempotency/reconciliationとfault/concurrency tests、(5) additive API/capability/docs/compatibility、(6) 4-review remediation、(7) non-self-referential completion evidenceとexact-final-HEAD cycleの非squash単位にする。

PD-31 Roadmap transition: explicit approval後にproposal scope objectだけをUTF-8、ensure_ascii=false、sorted keys、compact separatorsでcanonicalizeしSHA-256を計算する。approval record goal-rm027-p2-027b-2026-07-25をappendし、P2-027B approval referenceをbind、P2-027Bをin_progress、RM-027をin_progressのまま更新する。承認前にdigest計算やtracked変更をしない。

PD-32 Completion governance: candidate gatesと4レビュー後だけP2-027B completed、RM-027 completed、capability implementedへ進める。completion evidenceは既存prior commit/path/testだけを参照しself-referenceを含めない。P2-013B/P2-028Aはapproval null/not_started、RM-013はin_progressを維持する。

PD-33 Management/Git safety: tmp/goals/p2-027bのproposal/inventory/progress/decision/risk/review/test/final/logs、PLAN/PROGRESS、review transcript、test output、run artifact、user_materialsはignored/untracked/unstaged/uncommitted/unpushed/external-service-freeに保つ。git add .、git add -A、git add -f、reset、rebase、amend、force-pushを禁止し、承認済みtracked pathだけを明示stageする。

PD-34 Approval and release boundary: この全文の明示承認前はnew branch、tracked code/test/docs/roadmap変更、commit、pushを行わない。承認はP2-027B実装と全gate成立後の最終non-force pushだけを許可し、依存追加、外部code取得、実user data cleanup、PR、merge、tag、release、visibility変更を許可しない。

PD-35 Residual risks: same-privilege malicious writer、syscall間TOCTOU、Windows directory durability、power-loss、distributed filesystem、partial recursive unlink、control evidence retention後のpurgeは完全解決を主張しない。High/Medium findingはcompletion前にゼロとし、残るLowは具体的受容理由をrisk registerへ記録する。
